raw_text: BOOM Live fact-check: The video claiming to show an Indian Navy frigate sinking is fabricated. Our investigation found the ocean background footage matches a stock video from Shutterstock uploaded in 2021. The warship model appears to be a 3D render with AI-enhanced textures. Frame rate analysis shows inconsistencies between the ship animation and ocean surface movement. No maritime distress signals were recorded in the claimed area.
clean_text: BOOM Live confirms Navy sinking video is fabricated. Ocean background matches 2021 Shutterstock footage. Ship is 3D render with AI textures. No distress signals recorded.
